levels.surface: عبد الحميد خادم إسماعيل بن جعفر

notes: «حدثني أبي وأخي»: father and brother are named only by relation to the compiler's line, so relation kind; «(رحمه الله)» and «(ع)» left out
THQ's English puts Muhammad ibn Sinan between Husain ibn Sa'id and Abdul Malik; the Arabic writes no such link

fixes.reason: THQ's English places Muhammad ibn Sinan in the chain; the Arabic text does not write him.

evidence.quote: عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُمِّيِّ
